comments: The parser only reads the 'spec' section, so we can add anything we want here.
The 'spec' section must contain a list of at least one 'specblock'.
Each 'specblock' is a dictionary of axisname : [list of edge indices]
all of the axes in the histogram MUST be present in the specblock,
and all of the indices must be integers in the range [0, ax.extent].
Note that these are bin EDGE indices, bin bin indices
Eg for an axis with 10 bins, to reduce to one bin you want [0, 10].
